FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Pawnkind handling fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Some behind-the-scenes fixes for pawnkind handling

patchNoteLines.li: When playing with multiple races (i.e. with HAR), Empire creates runtime pawnKindDefs for each race. But, as runtime-created defs, they cannot be resolved when loading. This fix adds a patch to loading: on encountering a 'runtime def', the def is replaced with its template version. Then, once we actually recreate the runtime def, we assign it to the pawns that need it

additionalNotes.li: Please raise any issues you find on the Github page.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: FCPolicyDef update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds the ability to set required policies/traits/edicts for a new policy/trait/edict to be applied.

patchNoteLines.li: Add requiredPolicies and requirementMode fields to FCPolicyDef. If requiredPolicies is not empty, then all (or any) of the given policies must be active in order for the main def to be selectable

additionalNotes.li: Please raise any issues you find on the Github page.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: SettlementDef update

patchNoteLines.li: Adds baseUnlockedBuildings and perLevelUnlockedBuildings fields to WorldSettlementDef. The number of buildings unlocked at any given level is baseUnlockedBuildings + Floor(perLevelUnlockedBuildings * settlement level)

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Battle auto-resolve update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Changes the calculations for auto-resolve battles.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: More military fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Some more fixes for the military side of Empire.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Major Refactor
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updating version during major refactor.

patchNoteLines.li: Reworked FactionColonies class and the settings
Added a LogUtil class
Refactored settlements to use a single WorldSettlementFC class
Settlement types and resources defined through XML defs
Major UI rework (redid most of the mod's windows)
Road buildings uses a Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) for more organic-looking road networks
Faction policies and traits converted into defs
Repurposed old, unused policies into three new categories of Edicts
Reworked events to give the player a choice over how they respond
Reworked taxes: a snapshot of a settlement's production is taken each day. At tax time, the player recieves taxes based on the average of these daily snapshots
Numerous bug fixes to the manual battle system. It has been tentatively re-enabled. If it remains buggy, it may be disabled again
Military threat levels reworked. Settlement raids scale more
Numerous changes in the name of extensibility (refer to the Docs)
Compatibility patches for Humanoid Alien Races, Combat Extended, RimWar, World Domination, and Faction Territories & Vassalage. Some still need testing
Numerous other bugfixes; too many to note here

additionalNotes.li: Please raise any issues you find on the Github page.
